macro_vol_denoise — 2D macro op

• Data kinds: volume → volume

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "macro_vol_denoise", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

Usage

A fixed pipeline discovered by evolutionary search (3-D volume version): `vol_threshold(a=0.52,b=0.76) → vol_gaussian(a=0.08,b=0.89)` (2 stages: apply 3-D thresholding, then Gaussian smoothing).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a, b` は凍結済みで未使用。in_sort/out_sort は volume。volume の denoise 課題（PSNR）でロック済みホールドアウト 25.74dB、手作りベースライン20.94dB を上回る。HALCON に対応する単一オペレータは無い。
